checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Provider encryption substantiated for Grafana-owned data; source databases and exported dashboards/snapshots separately assessed.
checks.title: Grafana configuration/data and source stores

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Approved encryption and verification for each data source; do not assume external plugins/endpoints inherit Azure-managed transport guarantees.
checks.title: Browser and each data-source transport

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Automated tokens are justified, scoped, expired/rotated and revocable; do not collect token values or secureJsonData.
checks.title: Service-account tokens and data-source credentials

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Required event types are emitted/retained and missing categories recorded; dashboard request metrics alone do not prove all administrative audit.
checks.title: Authentication, administrative and datasource monitoring

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: No unapproved public snapshots/plugins/features; settings evaluated against actual Grafana major version and managed-service restrictions.
checks.title: Snapshot sharing, plugins and version-specific settings

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Supported service/version and reviewed plugin supplier risks; do not assume arbitrary plugin installation or every plugin's patches are customer-controlled.
checks.title: Managed Grafana and enabled plugin lifecycle

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Recover approved dashboards, alerting and data-source access within limits; zone redundancy is not cross-region disaster recovery or dashboard backup.
checks.title: Dashboard/configuration recovery and availability

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Approved principals can ingest/query only intended resource populations; workspace mode and source-resource rights considered together.
checks.title: Metrics ingestion and query scope

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Both paths satisfy policy; the workspace query private endpoint alone is not evidence of private remote-write/configuration ingestion.
checks.title: Ingestion versus query private connectivity

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Use the Prometheus workspace guarantee, never a Log Analytics resource as a substitute; external copies assessed separately.
checks.title: Azure Monitor workspace metric storage

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Required encryption covers workload-to-collector and collector-to-service hops; Azure query TLS does not imply every scrape target is encrypted.
checks.title: Scrape, remote write and query paths

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Credentials and client trust follow policy; no Kubernetes secrets or unfiltered scrape configuration collected.
checks.title: Scrape/remote-write identities and credential references

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Monitoring coverage and freshness meet approved criteria; time-series metrics are not a substitute for security audit logs of access/administrative actions.
checks.title: Scrape coverage, ingestion loss and rule health

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Collection rules match approved metrics with no sensitive/PII label data; review fixed service retention against requirements rather than inventing a retention toggle.
checks.title: DCR, scrape, cardinality and label privacy baseline

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Customer-deployed collectors/exporters supported/remediated; hosted metrics platform duties evidenced separately.
checks.title: Collector images and managed metrics platform

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Design meets acceptable metric-loss and restoration objectives; service retention is not a selectable independent backup/restore feature.
checks.title: Metric continuity and monitoring rebuild

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Query/write/delete rights fit approved duties; resource-scoped access and table permissions considered together; sensitive security tables have restricted access.
checks.title: Workspace, resource and table authorization

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Both ingestion/query and external exports match approved flow/location restrictions with shared network validation.
checks.title: Query, ingestion and export boundaries

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Provider keys accepted for the workspace scope; optional CMK configuration is not confused with base encryption and exports are independently assessed.
checks.title: Workspace stored logs, queries and exports

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Approved encrypted transport covers custom collectors and all ingestion/query paths, including proxies.
checks.title: Agent, collection and query transport

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Permitted agent/static credentials and optional keys follow lifecycle requirements; do not call workspace sharedKeys APIs.
checks.title: Agent credentials and optional key lifecycle

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Every required dataset is retained/retrievable and protected from purge/unauthorized query; cap/transform/ingestion failures cause actionable alerts.
checks.title: Table retention, query audit and ingestion health

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Changes preserve required audit content and privacy minimization; delete/retention changes and permission drift are reviewed.
checks.title: DCR transforms, tables and export change control

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Customer collectors are current and healthy; extension installed or managed service status does not establish actual collection or patching.
checks.title: Agents, query clients and managed service

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Required audit history and monitoring can be restored/retrieved within limits; export covers supported new data only, not an automatic historical full backup.
checks.title: Retained evidence availability and export recovery

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Approved guest/control-plane administrators only, strong selected authentication and limited remote administration; ARM role list does not enumerate local accounts.
checks.title: Azure administration and guest privileged access

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Required management/application paths restricted; no invented VM publicNetworkAccess switch; network team owns shared network changes.
checks.title: NIC exposure and host/service boundaries

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: All in-scope data paths have scoped protection; managed-disk SSE alone is not proof for temporary disks, cache, guest exports or remote stores.
checks.title: OS/data disks, cache/temp and remote mounts

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Approved secure transport on each listening/outbound service; no inference from VM type or one TLS endpoint.
checks.title: Guest application and management encryption

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Credentials are not embedded in images/scripts or broadly accessible; lifetimes/rotation meet approved requirements without reading key material.
checks.title: Guest secrets, SSH keys and certificates

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Selected guest events arrive with reliable timestamps; extension presence and Azure Activity Log alone are insufficient.
checks.title: Guest security events, clocks and agent health

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Approved OS/boot/application baseline enforced for the VM generation/workload; unsupported features explicitly reviewed.
checks.title: Guest hardening, boot integrity and drift

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Complete fresh scan/patch/malware coverage and timely remediation; automatic-patch setting is not completed patch evidence.
checks.title: Guest patching, malware defense and software support

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Required guest and external state recovers within RPO/RTO; crash-consistent snapshot or host availability alone does not establish application recovery.
checks.title: Application-consistent backup and VM recovery

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Approved rights on every instance, not only the model; guest and control-plane administration assessed separately.
checks.title: Model and instance identity/administrator rights

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: All instances and frontend/backend paths match approved restrictions; newly scaled instances inherit verified policy.
checks.title: Per-instance exposure and shared frontend

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Every relevant instance/store is covered; a compliant model cannot prove older instances adopted it or protect unknown temporary data.
checks.title: Model versus instance storage protection

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: All required hops and instances enforce approved encryption; load-balancer TLS does not prove backend TLS.
checks.title: Management, application and backend transport

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: No baked-in reusable secrets; new and existing instances receive current credentials and revoke retired access.
checks.title: Image and instance credential lifecycle

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Every expected instance reports selected audit events; terminated/failed-to-onboard instances remain visible coverage gaps.
checks.title: Instance audit coverage through scaling and upgrades

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Actual instances converge to approved model within allowed interval; manual/automatic/rolling policy selection alone is not convergence evidence.
checks.title: Upgrade policy and instance-model drift

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Complete actual-instance remediation and supported image lifecycle; rebuilt/scaled instances cannot silently reintroduce vulnerable images.
checks.title: Image, OS and extension patch coverage

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: State and capacity recover within requirements; do not presume Uniform and Flexible have identical VM backup support or that stateless model covers all applications.
checks.title: Capacity rebuild and state recovery

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Powerful runtime identity cannot be exercised by unapproved authors/operators; execution rights evaluated as potential credential/identity use.
checks.title: Runbook authoring, execution and runtime identity

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Each account/webhook/worker path meets approved boundary; private account configuration does not imply every webhook or hybrid dependency is private.
checks.title: Account endpoints, webhooks and worker connectivity

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Provider-managed encryption accepted for documented scopes; plaintext variables, output streams and exported scripts require explicit handling and redaction evidence.
checks.title: Secure assets, code and job/output stores

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: All required paths use approved encryption/validation; account TLS does not prove arbitrary runbook outbound protocol safety.
checks.title: Worker, webhook and runbook outbound transport

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Sensitive variables are protected and credentials rotate; never retrieve asset values, webhook URLs, private certificates or secret-bearing job output.
checks.title: Automation assets, webhook tokens and certificate expiry

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Job failures and privileged operations monitored; output redacted before archival because streams may contain secrets and personal data.
checks.title: Job status, administrative changes and audit delivery

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Only approved tested runbooks and dependencies execute; no raw script or source-control token retrieval required for inventory.
checks.title: Published code, source control and execution changes

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Supported worker/runtime/modules and remediated host vulnerabilities; provider service maintenance does not patch hybrid hosts or customer modules.
checks.title: Runtime, modules and Hybrid Worker hosts

checks.remaining_acceptance_boundary: Rebuild meets RTO and safely reestablishes identities/assets; Automation has no general native backup, so a documented tested alternative is required.
checks.title: Account rebuild and protected asset reconstitution
